claims.supporting_quote: A valuation of up to $150 billion and a capital raise of roughly $15 billion are under discussion.

claims.claim: SK hynix posted second-quarter operating profit of 60.5426 trillion won on revenue of 79.3187 trillion won.

claims.supporting_quote: In the second quarter, the company posted an operating profit of 60.5426 trillion won on revenue of 79.3187 trillion won.

claims.supporting_quote: According to research firm Counterpoint, SK Hynix held a 50% share of the global HBM market during the same period.

claims.supporting_quote: A listing of the NAND flash specialist could come as early as 2027.

claims.episode_span: AMD said Helios delivers over 18,000 CDNA 5 GPU compute units in a single rack.
claims.source_title: Helios Rack Runs Agentic AI at Scale with 18K+ CDNA 5 GPUs
claims.supporting_quote: Helios delivers over 18,000 CDNA 5 GPU compute units, 4,600 Zen 6 CPU cores and 31 TB of HBM4 memory.

claims.claim: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, with Oryon cores reaching 5 GHz for the first time, GPU matrix cores and LPDDR6.
claims.episode_span: New Oryon CPU cores reach 5 GHz for the first time.
claims.source_title: Qualcomm Unveils Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Elite Extreme Gen 6: Next Gen Flagship Mobile Chips
claims.supporting_quote: All the while, this generation introduces the latest generation of Qualcomm’s custom Oryon Arm-architecture CPU cores, bringing them to 5GHz for the first time.

claims.supporting_quote: (5G Adv Sub-6 + mmWave) DL = 12.5 Gbps Dual Active SIM (DSDA)

claims.source_title: Russia bombs Ukrainian data centers in latest escalation
claims.supporting_quote: The attacks have left 100,000 households in the area without an internet connection, although a senior government official claimed that the country's internet network is highly decentralized.

claims.claim: US chip export controls were not a main topic at the Xi-Trump summit, and Jamieson Greer said national-security export controls were not part of this week's trade negotiations.

claims.source_title: US export controls on chips were not a key topic at Xi-Trump summit — South China Morning Post
claims.supporting_quote: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told CNBC that export control issues related to national security were not considered as part of this week’s trade negotiations.

claims.claim: A Taipei-based research company forecasts foreign suppliers' share will fall to 21 percent in 2026 from 34 percent last year, and Nvidia wrote off $400 million in the first half on excess H200 inventory.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia wrote off $400 million in the first half on excess H200 inventory caused by approval delays.
claims.source_title: US export controls on chips were not a key topic at Xi-Trump summit — South China Morning Post
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia wrote off $400 million in the first half of the year due to excess H200 inventory caused by approval delays.

claims.claim: Paul Triolo warned the pause may be temporary and pointed to the Match Act, intended to coordinate Japan and the Netherlands on advanced chipmaking equipment sales to China.
claims.episode_span: Paul Triolo of DGA-Albright Stonebridge Group warned the pause may be temporary and pointed to the Match Act
claims.source_title: US export controls on chips were not a key topic at Xi-Trump summit — South China Morning Post
claims.supporting_quote: He drew attention to legislative initiatives in the US Congress, including the Match Act, which is intended to encourage Washington’s allies, including Japan and the Netherlands, to coordinate restrictions on sales of advanced chipmaking equipment to China.

claims.claim: Ninety-four percent of Guai Guai workers voted for a strike after a planned move to Hsinchu and a 5 percent pay offer, and ASE bought the Zhongli site for NT$5.6 billion, or US$176.1 million.
claims.episode_span: ASE bought the Zhongli site for NT$5.6 billion, or US$176.1 million, and the union says no share of that sum goes to workers.
claims.source_title: Taiwan's chip talisman snack faces production halt after 94% strike vote
claims.supporting_quote: This has netted the company NT$5.6 billion (US$176.1 million).

claims.claim: The Guai Guai union is seeking a NT$10,000, or US$315, monthly increase for workers who stay, plus written severance guarantees.
claims.episode_span: The union wants written severance guarantees and, for those who stay, a NT$10,000, or US$315, monthly increase.
claims.source_title: Taiwan's chip talisman snack faces production halt after 94% strike vote
claims.supporting_quote: Moreover it is seeking severance packages for those who don’t want to work so far away, and asking that workers who stay on get a NT$10,000 (US$315) monthly salary increase.

claims.claim: Ground was broken on September 21 for the Kaohsiung Baifu Industrial Park, planned as Taiwan's first advanced semiconductor equipment and materials verification center, with more than 20 suppliers planning to move in.
claims.episode_span: Asiae reports that more than 20 suppliers are already planning to move in
claims.source_title: [Taiwan Chip News] "Can't Keep Up Alone"... Why TSMC Is Rallying Domestic Partners
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC is committed to fully supporting the move-in of packaging equipment and materials partners, and it is reported that more than 20 suppliers are already planning to move in.

claims.claim: A standard factory at the Kaohsiung complex is scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 2028, with the verification laboratory and talent development center opening in phases in the fourth quarter of 2028.
claims.episode_span: Asiae says a standard factory is scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 2028
claims.source_title: [Taiwan Chip News] "Can't Keep Up Alone"... Why TSMC Is Rallying Domestic Partners
claims.supporting_quote: In the second quarter of 2028, a standard factory is scheduled for completion, followed by the phased opening of the verification laboratory and the talent development center in the fourth quarter of the same year.

claims.claim: Land leasing at Kaohsiung Baifu is set to begin in the first quarter of next year, with third-party testing services in the second quarter.
claims.episode_span: Starting in the first quarter of next year, companies are to begin leasing land and building at Kaohsiung Baifu, with third-party testing and inspection services in the second quarter, Asiae reports.
claims.source_title: [Taiwan Chip News] "Can't Keep Up Alone"... Why TSMC Is Rallying Domestic Partners
claims.supporting_quote: Starting in the first quarter of next year, companies and supply chain firms will begin leasing land and constructing their facilities, with third-party testing and inspection center services commencing in the second quarter.
